name: gate-sector
description: The one 512-byte gate layout every record shares, its invalidated form, and the checks that make it all-or-nothing.

cases.name: valid-journal-gate
cases.note: Magic, slot, scope, sequence, CRC and complement all agree.
cases.subject: gate

cases.name: invalidated-sector
cases.note: 512 zero bytes: invalidation needs no sentinel because it fails magic and CRC.
cases.subject: gate

cases.name: wrong-slot-index
cases.note: The same gate read at slot 1 is not a gate.
cases.subject: gate

cases.name: complement-not-exact
cases.note: The one's complement copy of the body CRC is off by one bit.
cases.subject: gate

cases.name: unknown-version
cases.note: Format version 2 is not a version this build knows.
cases.subject: gate

cases.name: nonzero-reserved-tail
cases.note: Bytes 36..512 are reserved and must be zero when read.
cases.subject: gate

cases.name: gate-crc-mismatch
cases.note: The gate's own CRC does not cover its 512 bytes.
cases.subject: gate
